column1: # pk-upright, 2026-10-15. Production OCRModel.start outputs read, selected, searched and rendered through PDFKit.
# Before: 429ad66; nine fresh Falcon outputs reproduce the prior measurement exactly in text and PNG render.
# Other baseline outputs are PK-PHOTO-MEASURE-2026-10-14's PDFs. Both readers after: this fix, all 31 source photos.
# Eight pages remain turned in production; pk04's HEIC is already upright after wrapping and is an unchanged control.
# Truth-band scoring follows PK-PHOTO-MEASURE: multiset word misses, contested words excluded; 774 print + 84 handwriting.
# text_same is the exact PDFKit string; render_same is the exact 1100 px PDFKit PNG; box_same is the published media size.
# find_lines counts each PDFKit selection line whose string Find returns. new_tokens/model_tokens are diagnostic word bags:
# model_tokens are new tokens found whole in the saved model reading; hyphen splits/partial compounds explain the exceptions.
# model_calls/upright_view_calls count traced reader invocations and ones passed the new upright PNG. Zero calls on Paddle pk19:
# the layout detector found no region. Paddle pk28's unrelated reading fails the existing anchor guard, keeping Vision.
